ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Nimit Rajesh Ghatalia, a promoter of Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd, has increased their shareholding to 5.18% (1,650,000 shares) from 4.88% by converting 150,000 warrants into equity shares. This transaction, reported under SEBI regulations, resulted in a modest increase in the company's outstanding equity capital but represents a standard warrant conversion by an insider, not indicating immediate red flags for external investors.
